name: Guardian genius crossword No 194
preamble: Six solutions are related; their clues are normal but the definitions in their clues have been swapped around. A further six clues lack any definition, but these are to be found as one of the solutions to the first six. With eight other solutions, a single letter from one of the original six must be added to the wordplay in their clues. With the remaining eight solutions, a single letter from the original six must be removed from their wordplay.

solutions.check: grid and clues read from the Guardian's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; each light's entry one fifteensquared prints for it, the only choice of them whose crossings all agree; an entry not its answer carries the answer as its alteration's `from`

clue.text: Attempt, say, to use line, getting more twisted

definitions.note: per the preamble this definition was swapped in from another of the six related clues; it defines TANGLIER

indicators.note: 'say' asks us to take the word attempt as it is spoken rather than spelt

blocks.note: an attempt is a try, written here as it sounds
to fish with rod and line is to angle

explanation.surface: Someone trying to use a piece of string finds it getting ever more knotted.
explanation.walkthrough: This is one of the six related answers, all anagrams of each other, so its printed definition belongs to TANGLIER; its own definition, 'figure', sits in 9 Across.
explanation.definitionFit: The real definition, shown in another clue, is a figure: a three-sided plane shape in geometry.

clue.text: Therapy starts with doctor in operation

indicators.note: the start of therapy means only its opening letter is wanted

blocks.note: first letter of therapy
to doctor results is to rig them
a machine in operation is on

explanation.surface: Treatment begins with a physician in surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue has no definition: per the preamble TRIGON is defined by TRIANGLE, the answer to 1 Across.
explanation.definitionFit: A trigon is an old term for a triangle, a plane figure with three angles.

clue.text: Assured of success with diplomacy

blocks.note: a candidate sure to win is said to be in
tact is diplomacy

explanation.surface: Someone confident of winning thanks to their diplomatic skills.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue has no definition: per the preamble INTACT is defined by INTEGRAL, the answer to 9 Across.
explanation.definitionFit: Integral can mean whole and undivided, and something intact is complete with nothing missing.

clue.text: Almost nothing is resolved

indicators.note: something resolved is broken down and worked out afresh, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Hardly any problem has been settled.
explanation.walkthrough: Per the preamble, one letter of TRIANGLE is removed from the wordplay here: T comes out of NOTHING before the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Nigh on is an idiom for nearly, so it can stand in for almost.

clue.text: Permeating in general with irony — very 'in'

indicators.note: irony says the opposite of what it means, so the words are not to be taken straight but twisted round
the quoted 'in' tells us literally to put the very letter inside

blocks.note: taken as written
V is the abbreviation for very

explanation.surface: An ironic tone runs through everything, very much in fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: Per the preamble, one letter of TRIANGLE is removed from the wordplay here: R comes out of IN GENERAL, and the remaining letters with V are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaven spreads through dough, so leavening describes something pervading and transforming a whole mass.

clue.text: Accepted anguish of spirit

blocks.note: A is the abbreviation for accepted
the letter the preamble says must be added to this wordplay
the rack is torment, as on the torture device

explanation.surface: Someone resigned to deep spiritual anguish.
explanation.walkthrough: Per the preamble, one letter of TRIANGLE is added to the wordplay here: A plus RACK needs an extra R.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrack is an alcoholic spirit distilled in South and Southeast Asia from palm sap or rice.

clue.text: Former German currency rises on bank warning

definitions.note: per the preamble this definition was swapped in; it defines ALERTING

indicators.note: in a down entry rising means reading upwards, so the old coin's name runs backwards

blocks.note: the taler or thaler was an old German silver coin
ING is a Dutch banking group

explanation.surface: An old German currency gains value, prompting a bank to issue a warning.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts the first part above the second. 'Warning' is ALERTING's definition; this answer's own, 'Linking', is in 7 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: The real definition, 'linking', fits: relating things means connecting or associating them with each other.

clue.text: Linking fabricated tale with criminal bloc

definitions.note: per the preamble this definition was swapped in; it defines RELATING

indicators.note: a fabricated story is made up, so these letters are reconstructed into another order

blocks.note: taken as written
a ring is a gang of criminals

explanation.surface: Someone connects an invented story to a gang of crooks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Linking' is RELATING's definition; ALTERING's own, 'Perhaps taking in', is in 17 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: The real definition, 'perhaps taking in', fits: taking in a garment is one example of modifying or changing it.

clue.text: Maybe granny goes on stage

blocks.note: a granny is a kind of knot
a tier is a level or stage

explanation.surface: An elderly grandmother takes to the stage to perform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Granny' is the granny knot, not a grandmother. The clue has no definition: per the preamble KNOTTIER is defined by TANGLIER, the answer to 16 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are comparative adjectives describing string or a problem that is more snarled and complicated.

clue.text: Big returns on international figure

definitions.note: per the preamble this definition was swapped in; it defines TRIANGLE

indicators.note: something that returns goes back the way it came, so the word for big is read backwards

blocks.note: standard abbreviation for international
big means large

explanation.surface: A large figure is returned on some international measure, like a big statistic.
explanation.walkthrough: INT followed by LARGE reversed (EGRAL) gives INTEGRAL. 'Figure' is TRIANGLE's definition; INTEGRAL's own, 'Built in', appears in 16 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: The real definition, 'built in', fits: something integral is an inherent, essential constituent of a whole.

clue.text: Well-oiled automaton, excessively lacking in love

indicators.note: lacking in means going without, so one letter of the excessive word is dropped

blocks.note: a bot is a robot
the letter the preamble says must be added to this wordplay
too means excessively
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: A smoothly lubricated robot that is sadly short of affection.
explanation.walkthrough: The preamble's added letter here is L, which goes in after the first letter of the automaton word.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-oiled is slang for drunk, and blotto is informal British slang for very drunk.

clue.text: Casual assessment of former partner

blocks.note: once means formerly
a lover is a partner

explanation.surface: A quick look at an ex.
explanation.walkthrough: Per the preamble, one letter of TRIANGLE is removed from the wordplay here: L comes out of LOVER.
explanation.definitionFit: A once-over is a quick, superficial inspection or look, hence a casual assessment.

clue.text: Wear down disagreeable trait

indicators.note: disagreeable suggests letters that do not sit well together, so they are reordered

blocks.note: taken as written
the letter the preamble says must be added to this wordplay

explanation.surface: An unpleasant character trait grinds people down.
explanation.walkthrough: Per the preamble, one letter of TRIANGLE is added to the wordplay here: an extra T joins TRAIT before the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Attrit is a back-formation from attrition, meaning to weaken or erode gradually by constant pressure.

clue.text: Combination of clashing sounds is very much part of performance art

indicators.note: becoming part of something means going inside it

blocks.note: dance is a performing art
taken as written
so means very much, as in 'so tired'
the letter the preamble says must be added to this wordplay

explanation.surface: Discordant noise is a big element of avant-garde performance art.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay comes up one letter short; the preamble's added letter here is N, one of the letters of TRIANGLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Dissonance in music is a jarring mixture of notes that do not harmonise.

clue.text: Perhaps earth slab illuminated within

indicators.note: within says the word for illuminated sits inside the slab word

blocks.note: a stele is an upright stone slab bearing an inscription
the letter the preamble says must be added to this wordplay
lit means illuminated

explanation.surface: Perhaps a lump of soil in a slab, lit up from the inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Earth' looks like soil but is the planet. The preamble's added letter here is A, placed after the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth orbits the sun, so it is one example of a body circling another, which is what a satellite is.

clue.text: If things are not as they should be

indicators.text: are not as they should be
indicators.note: things not as they should be are out of their proper order, so the letters need rearranging

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A general complaint that matters are wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue has no definition: per the preamble SHIFTING is defined by ALTERING, the answer to 7 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: Shifting and altering are synonyms, both meaning changing position or form.

clue.text: Built in African city, providing setting for library's foundation

definitions.note: per the preamble this definition was swapped in; it defines INTEGRAL

indicators.note: a foundation is the base, and in a down entry the start of the word library sits at its head
providing a setting means surrounding something like a jewel in a mount

blocks.note: the Moroccan port city
first letter of library

explanation.surface: A library constructed in a North African city, with the city as the setting for its foundation stone.
explanation.walkthrough: TANGIER around L gives TANGLIER. 'Built in' is INTEGRAL's definition; TANGLIER's own, 'getting more twisted', is in 1 Across.
explanation.definitionFit: The real definition, 'getting more twisted', matches a comparative adjective meaning more knotted or snarled up.

clue.text: Perhaps taking in drink, leading to foolish grin with time

definitions.note: per the preamble this definition was swapped in; it defines ALTERING

indicators.note: foolish suggests the grin and time letters behaving without sense, jumbled up

blocks.note: ale is beer
taken as written
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Taking in a drink leads someone to break into a silly grin after a while.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps taking in' is ALTERING's definition; ALERTING's own, 'warning', is in 6 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: The real definition, 'warning', fits: alerting someone is cautioning them about danger.

clue.text: Suffered with lungs — said to be nemesis of rabbits

definitions.text: said to be nemesis of rabbits

blocks.note: to have had something is to have suffered it, as with an illness
the letter the preamble says must be added to this wordplay
lights are the lungs of slaughtered animals, a butcher's term

explanation.surface: Someone who suffered with lung disease, spoken of as a deadly threat to rabbits.
explanation.walkthrough: The preamble's added letter here is E, placed inside the first part. Rabbits famously freeze in the glare of an oncoming car.
explanation.definitionFit: Car lamps at night are proverbially deadly to rabbits, which freeze 'like a rabbit in the headlights'.

clue.text: Coffee perhaps produced in French former Asian protectorate

blocks.note: coffee is brown, and brown in French is brun, brune in the feminine
the letter the preamble says must be added to this wordplay

explanation.surface: Coffee grown in a French-run former colony in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: Per the preamble, one letter of TRIANGLE is added to the wordplay here: I follows the French word for brown.
explanation.definitionFit: Brunei, on Borneo, was a British protectorate until gaining independence in 1984.

clue.text: Beauty spot found by search engine covering several outlying parts of Delhi

indicators.note: outlying parts are the outer edges, so a few letters from each end of the city name are kept
covering means wrapping round, so the search engine goes outside

blocks.note: Microsoft's search engine
the first letter and last two letters of Delhi

explanation.surface: A tourist beauty spot located by online search, covering areas on the edge of Delhi.
explanation.walkthrough: The preamble's removed letter here is G, the search engine's last letter. BINDHI is a less common spelling of bindi.
explanation.definitionFit: A bindhi (more often bindi) is the decorative dot worn on the forehead by South Asian women.

clue.text: With a final twist, encourage to drink

indicators.note: a twist at the end turns round the closing letters of the word for encourage

blocks.note: to egg on is to encourage
the letter the preamble says must be added to this wordplay

explanation.surface: Someone persuaded, with a last-minute change of heart, to have a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: EGG ON with its final two letters turned round gives EGGNO; per the preamble a G from TRIANGLE is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggnog is a drink of eggs, milk, sugar and often spirits, popular at Christmas.

clue.text: Source of money conceals newspaper's backing for African writer

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the paper word is read from the end
to conceal is to hide inside, so the money word wraps around

blocks.note: a fund is a source of money
a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper

explanation.surface: A financial backer hides the fact that a paper is supporting an African author.
explanation.walkthrough: The preamble's removed letter here is N, taken from the money source once it has swallowed the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Athol Fugard is a South African playwright and novelist, author of Tsotsi and Master Harold.

clue.text: Marginal movement after reorganisation

indicators.note: letters that move about after being reorganised end up in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A fringe political movement emerges after a party shake-up.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue has no definition: per the preamble ALARMING is defined by ALERTING, the answer to 17 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarming someone and alerting them both mean warning them of danger, so the two participles match.

clue.text: Ignoring regular indications in diagnosis is concerning, principally relating to part of the eye

definitions.text: relating to part of the eye

indicators.note: principally points to the principal, leading letter of each word

blocks.clueFragment: Ignoring regular indications in diagnosis is concerning
blocks.note: first letters of the seven words

explanation.surface: A doctor overlooks routine signs in a worrying eye diagnosis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ignoring' tempts as a deletion signal but is just one of the seven words supplying initials. Per the preamble one I, a letter of TRIANGLE, is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Iridic is the adjective for the iris, the coloured part of the eye.

clue.text: Daniel's no stranger here

indicators.note: made stranger means made more unusual, so the letters before it are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Biblical Daniel is perfectly familiar with some place.
explanation.walkthrough: Per the preamble the A, a letter of TRIANGLE, is removed before the rearrangement. The whole clue also describes the place: Daniel had been there before and survived.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Book of Daniel, the prophet is thrown into a lions' den and survives, so he knows the place well.

clue.text: Where vehicle may be left in gear a long time

blocks.note: taken as written
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: A car left in gear for ages somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: GEAR plus AGE gives GEARAGE; per the preamble the first E, a letter of TRIANGLE, is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A garage is a building where a car is parked and kept.

clue.text: Taking on union ringleader, dismissed

indicators.note: dismissed staff are sent away, so these leading letters are taken out

blocks.note: an employer taking on staff is recruiting
the leaders, or first letters, of union and ring

explanation.surface: A firm recruits but sacks the trade union's agitator.
explanation.walkthrough: RECRUITING loses U and R. The clue has no definition: per the preamble RECITING is defined by RELATING, the answer to 6 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate a story is to tell it, and reciting is telling or narrating aloud.
